title: GitHub CLI: Media in issues, pull requests, and comments
summary: GitHub CLI now has a repeatable --attach flag that uploads a local image or video and references it inline in an issue, pull request, or comment body.[^c-4763577677]

title: Claude Fable 5.1 is generally available in GitHub Copilot
summary: Claude Fable 5.1 from Anthropic is now available in GitHub Copilot.[^c-8386a3f0a9] The latest model in Anthropic’s Mythos class, Claude Fable 5.1 is designed for long-horizon, autonomous coding and knowledge-work tasks.[^c-e852fe9868] In our internal testing, Claude Fable 5.1 demonstrated strong performance on substantial, long-running coding tasks, including deep codebase research, feature development, and complex agentic workflows.[^c-508d4e7782]

title: Block users from discussion comments in personal repositories
summary: You can now block or unblock users directly from discussion comments in repositories owned by personal GitHub accounts, extending the in-context blocking controls already available for issue and pull request comments.[^c-a6b9b33bab]

title: Copilot code review can now approve pull requests
summary: Copilot now tells you when a pull request is ready to approve, and admins can authorize it to sign off on approval.[^c-43be6b3844] The ability for Copilot to approve is off by default and configurable at the enterprise, organization, and repository level.[^c-3d4e4fa9b9] The approval assessments will now appear as a part of the overview comment in every Copilot review.[^c-f52b56b110]

title: Set an expiration date for individual user budgets
summary: You can now set an optional expiration date on an individual user budget, and GitHub removes the budget on that date.[^c-0a11d8a31d]

title: Enterprise Live Migrations from GHES to ghe.com generally available
Today I will… review GitHub PRs
How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality
summary: Why shorter outputs can cost more, and how GitHub Copilot reduces wasted work across the complete coding task.[^c-8e4d007b22] Output quality is important when working with AI coding agents, but true efficiency comes from getting work done quickly, efficiently, and with the right context.[^c-2ac9c724ca] That’s why token count of individual interactions alone isn’t a meaningful measure of efficiency.[^c-a65dcd6bf7]

title: Decoding the new AI lingo: Loops, harnesses, squads, hill climbing… oh my!
summary: From loop engineering to harnesses, squads, and open weights, the GitHub Podcast breaks down the AI terms showing up in developer conversations.[^c-d46920df63]

title: Content exclusions generally available in Copilot app and CLI
summary: The GitHub Copilot app and Copilot CLI now respect content exclusion policies configured by enterprise, organization, and repository administrators.[^c-50bf27b84f] Copilot won’t use excluded files as context, helping you protect sensitive code across agentic workflows.[^c-f18443620b]

title: Enterprise-managed settings support any default model
summary: You can now set your preferred GitHub Copilot model as the default for new conversations through enterprise-managed settings.[^c-f223e985b3]

title: Stop alt-tabbing into the wrong Visual Studio
summary: A user asked for per-solution color themes.[^c-ea505d61cb]

title: Redesigned new-session input
summary: Start delegated work with less setup in the redesigned new-session input.[^c-b5b4b98fe3] The updated experience brings the prompt, model selection, workspace selection, and other session controls together in one layout.[^c-cdea92bf03]

title: Improved workspace resolution
summary: Agents can resolve workspaces by their project name in addition to absolute paths and workspace URIs.[^c-ce4570a04d] Session tools also preserve project URIs and all working directories for multi-root workspaces.[^c-0593cea96f] As a result, you can make requests such as "run this in the vscode workspace" without providing a full path.[^c-b2b1eb6b72]

title: Navigate related chats and sessions
summary: Keep related agent work organized and move between sessions and chats from the sessions list in the Agents window.[^c-582f4eaacc] Chats appear as children of their parent session, so you can understand which chats belong together without managing a collection of unrelated sessions.[^c-a4f4829085] Each chat row shows its own title, status, and pending approvals, so you can see which chat needs your input.[^c-d5c31ad639]

title: Readable breadcrumbs for session files
summary: Files created in the internal session state directory previously showed internal session identifiers in editor breadcrumbs.[^c-1f26a6847c] Breadcrumbs now use stable provider and session labels, making it easier to identify the file location without exposing implementation details.[^c-5789871f14]

title: Chat backgrounds in the Agents window (Experimental)
summary: Personalize the Agents window with a decorative chat background: either a theme-aware pattern of built-in VS Code icons or an image of your own.[^c-458223449b] Run Chat: Set Background... to choose between the Codicons pattern and an image from your machine.[^c-c9149ef450]

title: Agent session notifications
summary: VS Code can notify you when an agent session needs your input or finishes its work.[^c-dcb5a469bc]

title: Agent merge (Preview)
summary: Agent merge helps you take a pull request across the finish line.[^c-8b3412879f]

title: Agent host
summary: The agent host lets you connect to the same agent session from multiple VS Code windows.[^c-93b87ed04d]

title: Enterprise controls for dictation data
summary: Administrators can manage the dictation model and language-model transcript cleanup through enterprise policies.[^c-37d92b0d6d] The new controls make it possible to require on-device transcription and disable language-model cleanup, so dictation remains available while preventing dictation data from being sent to cloud transcription or a Copilot model.[^c-d6deebff56]

title: Screen Reader Optimized badge in the Agents window
summary: The Screen Reader Optimized badge in the Agents window title bar makes the active accessibility mode easier to identify.[^c-74a0d41807] The badge appears when Screen Reader Optimized mode is enabled.[^c-ceef459063] Select the badge to disable this mode.[^c-5b48b7a914]

title: Layout density for the editor window (Experimental)
summary: Fit more content in the editor window with the Compact layout density.[^c-3e9a5b279e]

title: Word wrapping improvements
summary: Injected text no longer pushes wrapped lines outside the editor viewport.[^c-dfd729b93b] Word wrapping takes the visual width of color decorators, inlay hint spacing, inline progress indicators, and breakpoint placeholders into account.[^c-938ce46b18] Please have a look below for the before and after screenshots.[^c-8ba141c615]

title: Spell check suggestions
summary: Right-click a misspelled word in an editable field to select a suggested correction.[^c-cf0a8c96d7]

title: Reduced delay when running commands
summary: Terminal commands executed by extensions no longer incur an unnecessary delay when shell integration is ready under certain timing conditions.[^c-ff9d321599] Users of the JavaScript debugger who hit this case will no longer experience a five-second delay when starting their programs.[^c-1c62e6b4a3]

title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Run several agents at once
summary: Learn how to run parallel agents in the GitHub Copilot app, and experience the moment it stops feeling scary and starts feeling powerful.[^c-6ad84ec3ed] Running multiple AI agents on the same project seems like pure chaos, with too many cooks in your development kitchen.[^c-5287b85560]

title: GitHub Actions: Early September 2026 updates
summary: GitHub Actions now includes three updates that give you clearer visibility and finer-grained control over your workflows.[^c-dd030e8965]

title: CodeQL 2.26.4 improves GitHub actions security detections
summary: CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which finds and remediates security issues in your code.[^c-e3c929b7ff]

title: Reopening Copilot Business and Enterprise signups
Gemini 3.8 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot
summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash, Google’s latest Flash model, is now available in GitHub Copilot.[^c-a32cc7cca7] In our early testing, Gemini 3.8 Flash performed strongly on complex terminal-based coding tasks and demonstrated rigorous validation and persistent recovery from actionable failures.[^c-d196bc273f]

title: GitHub CLI Linux package signing key expires September 5
summary: The current PGP key for the GitHub CLI Linux package repositories expires on Saturday, September 5, 2026.[^c-e3fe5830e4] Beginning with the first release after that date, APT and RPM repository metadata and newly published RPM packages will be signed with just the replacement key.[^c-84ca778650] In April, we published a keyring containing both the current and replacement keys.[^c-0cd9cfb5f1]

title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models
Multiple trusted publishing configurations for npm
Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
summary: In controlled offline evaluations, HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline while reducing estimated workflow cost.[^c-d727638fc3] Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.[^c-538d23013e] Providing developers the best model for the task at hand has always been our goal.[^c-a301e39fe5]

title: New API endpoint provides privacy-safe star history data
summary: Track repository star growth over time with the new star history REST API endpoint without exposing stargazer identities.[^c-34f5d3ce2e] Earlier this year, stargazer listing endpoints were restricted to admins and collaborators to protect user privacy.[^c-3c29b5f724] Now you can get the insights you need with a privacy-safe alternative.[^c-bde3a76ae1]

title: GPT-6 Astra is generally available in GitHub Copilot
summary: GPT-6 Astra from OpenAI is now available in GitHub Copilot.[^c-9a4615ddb7] OpenAI’s latest general-purpose model, GPT-6 Astra, is designed for long-horizon, autonomous coding and agentic tasks.[^c-927812cd3a] In our internal testing, GPT-6 Astra stood out for how it works, not just what it produces: it plans and validates as it goes, batches diagnosis with verification, and independently confirms its results before declaring a task done.[^c-4a44d48df6]

title: Automatic Dependabot access to GitHub-hosted registries
summary: Dependabot can now read from private GitHub Packages registries without a personal access token.[^c-a8402dd793] If a package has granted your repository access through “Manage Actions access” in the package settings, Dependabot reuses that grant.[^c-753bb93e73]

title: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is now generally available
summary: GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) 3.22 is now available and introduces new capabilities across the platform.[^c-48443703c1]

title: Enterprise-managed sandbox in Copilot for JetBrains
Today I will… find hidden latency across a distributed .NET application
summary: When a distributed application feels slow, the user sees one delay.[^c-0dee15c82b] The code behind that delay may run across a web frontend, backend services, databases, and external APIs.[^c-96cfcde556] If you profile only the frontend while the backend is slow, the profiler can show that the frontend is healthy without revealing the actual bottleneck.[^c-eba421048d]

title: GitHub availability report: August 2026
summary: In August, we experienced five incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services.[^c-f60774f82e] While we continue to make progress, August proved to be a challenging month for availability.[^c-8b244bd23a] You can read more about these incidents in a blog post we published last month.[^c-c4f2a1556d]

title: Enterprise managed permissions for GitHub Copilot agent operations
summary: If you administer GitHub Copilot Business or GitHub Copilot Enterprise, you can now centrally control which agent operations are blocked, require human approval, or can proceed without a prompt.[^c-76b86b7c86] Managed permissions cover shell commands, file reads and edits, and network domains.[^c-548070addc]

title: Remediate Code Quality findings with agentic autofix
summary: Agentic autofix is now available to help you burn down findings in your code quality backlog.[^c-5822a3e1f9] You can select up to 25 standard findings on a page and assign the whole set to Copilot in one action.[^c-11f5bddd11] Copilot starts fixing them agentically on a branch, validates its own changes, then opens a pull request for you to review and merge.[^c-385b29623f]

title: Block pull requests with exposed secrets from merging
summary: Repository rulesets allow you to easily add scalable protections across your repositories.[^c-0276366261] Starting today, you can use repository rulesets to block pull requests from merging when the pull request introduces secret scanning alerts.[^c-6ca9c7345a]

title: GitHub Advanced Security expands trial availability
summary: More GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers can now start a self-serve GitHub Advanced Security trial to evaluate GitHub Code Security and GitHub Secret Protection.[^c-407d8cdbc4] Eligibility has expanded from enterprises with up to 100 licenses to enterprises with up to 300 licenses.[^c-02f0fa5c6e] To set up a GitHub Advanced Security trial, go to the Enterprise “Billing and licensing” page.[^c-05fe33415d]

title: CodeQL 2.27.0 adds support for Linux ARM64
summary: CodeQL 2.27.0 is now available on Linux ARM64, adds a new Rust security query, expanded framework coverage for Java/Kotlin and C#, and analysis accuracy improvements across multiple languages.[^c-1360c6757a] CodeQL is the static analysis engine behind GitHub code scanning, which helps you find and remediate security issues in your code.[^c-c83dad4b61]

title: npm extends recovery-code security holds to all accounts
Automations (Preview)
summary: Automations run recurring agent tasks on a schedule, so routine work does not have to be started manually.[^c-0f38cf3f61] Start with a template for catching up on changes, triaging issues, or finding bugs, or define your own prompt and schedule.[^c-0ea3075f0d]

title: Open GitHub issues and PR details (Experimental)
summary: When a chat conversation references work on GitHub, the Agents window can provide direct integration with the GitHub Pull Requests extension.[^c-20c9f4691d] Select a github.com issue or pull request link to open its details directly in the Agents window, without switching to a browser.[^c-46eaf6a11c]

title: Attach GitHub issues and pull requests in any chat
summary: Add a GitHub issue or pull request as context from the Add Context... menu in any chat input, including the Chat view, Chat editor, and Agents window.[^c-5f144dd18a]

title: Help name the VS Code pet (Experimental)
summary: The experimental VS Code pet is an interactive companion that reacts as you work with agents.[^c-2846fd9f2b] Enter /vscode-pet in chat to meet it, then help choose its name.[^c-a4ef69a252]

title: Continue quick chats in a workspace
summary: You can start a quick chat in the Agents window without associating it with a workspace, for example, to discuss general questions or ideas.[^c-cfad867c07] If the conversation later becomes project-specific, ask the Copilot agent to attach a local folder and continue the same chat.[^c-6e771a56e4] After you confirm the workspace and choose whether to use the folder directly or create an isolated worktree, the chat becomes a workspace session.[^c-7717fe9aea]

title: Agent-queued messages
summary: Keep agents working in parallel without interrupting a chat that is already processing a request.[^c-c44662818f] When an agent uses the send_message session-management tool to contact a busy chat, VS Code queues the message and starts it after the active turn completes successfully.[^c-ed2f20de4d] An agent can queue multiple messages for chats in the same session or another session.[^c-ac37bcc91a]

title: Voice Mode (Experimental)
summary: Voice Mode enables you to have a natural, spoken conversation with an agent while it works on your code.[^c-753bb3ec58]

title: Smart diff editor layout
summary: Choose a diff layout in the same way across regular diffs, multi-file diffs, and the Agents window Changes editor.[^c-db3a1c6a8f]

title: Binary files in multi-file diffs
summary: Changed binary files, such as images, remain visible in multi-file diffs instead of being omitted.[^c-e5821420a0] The diff shows a Binary file changed placeholder in the file's original position.[^c-7ce6348d90] Select Open Diff to review the file in the standard diff experience, such as an image diff or applicable custom editor.[^c-b7db7702a5]

title: GitHub links in the Markdown editor (Experimental)
summary: GitHub issue and pull request links in the Markdown editor show the current title and state, so you can understand each reference without opening it first.[^c-61961cb8c7] The link updates when its issue or pull request state changes, including CI updates.[^c-098c098245]

title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser
summary: Checking agent-generated code usually means hopping between tabs.[^c-24fab88260] Learn how to view diffs, run terminal commands, and preview web apps side by side in the GitHub Copilot app.[^c-4766532c5d] When an agent makes a change to your code, you want to review it, run it, and see what changed.[^c-7c434e8b05]

title: Xcode 27 runner image now runs on macOS 27
summary: You can now validate your Apple apps against macOS 27 using the Xcode 27 runner image for GitHub-hosted macOS runners, available in public preview.[^c-345ab09430] The image previously ran on macOS 26.[^c-1e9d19a653] How you target the image stays the same.[^c-835e98effc]

title: Control GitHub Actions cache access with cache-mode
summary: You can now use cache-mode to apply least-privilege access to the GitHub Actions cache at the workflow or job level.[^c-715c331db0] By granting each workflow or job only the cache access it needs, you can prevent unnecessary restores or saves and help protect trusted workflows from cache poisoning.[^c-f4326a04af]

title: AI Scan for pull request APIs in public preview
summary: You can now manage GitHub code scanning’s AI Scan for pull request enablement with REST API endpoints at the organization and repository levels.[^c-cb20d2b5cf]
